title: Idea
description: Forty cut words packed into a lightbulb, with IDEA raised deeper than the rest and finished in brass. Reads as a shape from across the floor and as language from two metres.
alt: Lightbulb built from dozens of raised cut words, with the word IDEA large and gold at its centre

title: Growth
description: The vocabulary of a company that is scaling, packed into one silhouette. Sprayed MDF, so the hero word can be matched to an exact brand colour without a premium.
alt: Word cloud of raised cut letters forming a bulb shape with the word GROWTH picked out in colour

title: Collective
description: A square word cloud for the wall above a bank of desks, built from the words a team actually uses in its stand-ups rather than the ones on a poster.
alt: Square arrangement of raised cut words with the word TEAM largest at the centre

title: Deep Work
description: Made for the quiet end of a floor: the words that describe concentration, cut in matte acrylic so nothing under the downlights turns into a mirror.
alt: Lightbulb word cloud in raised white letters with the word FOCUS at its centre

title: Think Outside the Box
description: Four words at the scale of the wall, with a noughts-and-crosses grid broken by a winning line underneath. The line is the whole joke, and it is cut in brass.
alt: The words THINK OUTSIDE THE BOX in large raised letters above a noughts-and-crosses grid struck through by one line

title: Begin Anyway
description: Two words for the wall people pass on the way to a hard meeting. Cut in dark PVC on a colour wall, which is the combination that reads from furthest away.
alt: The words BEGIN ANYWAY in large raised dark letters on a bright wall

title: Ship It Then Fix It
description: A landscape statement for the wall above a long desk run. Acrylic on 12 mm standoffs, so each word throws its own shadow and the line has depth along its length.
alt: The words SHIP IT THEN FIX IT in raised cut letters across a wide wall

title: Ask Better Questions
description: A panoramic line for a corridor, where a piece is read while walking past rather than while standing still. Sprayed MDF in a matched brand colour.
alt: The words ASK BETTER QUESTIONS in raised letters running along a wide corridor wall

title: Bright Ideas
description: Six outline bulbs on wires, each carrying one word, printed as a continuous coloured line. Light enough to mount with tape, which keeps a leased wall intact.
alt: Six outlined lightbulbs in bright colours hanging on wires, each containing one word

title: Hanging Goals
description: A panoramic run of outline bulbs at alternating drops, so the row reads as hung rather than ruled. Colour is the filament, so there is no finish to chip.
alt: A wide row of outlined lightbulbs on wires at alternating heights, each holding a word

title: Lit
description: Four bulbs rather than six, for a narrower wall or the space between two windows. The same continuous-line print, sized so each word still reads from across the room.
alt: Four outlined lightbulbs in bright colours on wires, each holding a single word

title: Six Questions
description: The questions a team should be able to answer, one to a bulb, along a classroom or corridor wall. Printed in six colours so each reads as its own idea.
alt: Six outlined lightbulbs in different colours along a wide wall, each carrying one word

title: House Rules
description: Five words at deliberately unequal sizes and alternating alignment, so the group reads as a composition rather than an enlarged bullet list. Brushed aluminium.
alt: Five value words in raised brushed metal letters at varying sizes, alternately left and right aligned

title: What We Stand For
description: For the wall behind a reception desk, where the words are read while someone waits. One word raised deeper than the rest so the group has a centre.
alt: A composed group of raised value words at varying sizes, one deeper than the others

title: Team Charter
description: The words a team agreed on, cut in acrylic and mounted where they cannot be minimised. Every word is yours; the composition is the part we do.
alt: Raised acrylic value words composed as a single group on a dark wall

title: How We Work
description: A landscape values board for a meeting-room wall, sized so it reads from the far end of the table. PVC foam, so it mounts with tape on a wall that cannot be drilled.
alt: A wide composition of raised value words at varying sizes across a meeting room wall

title: Sabr
description: The word for patience, cut as dimensional letterforms so the stroke gains a real edge and a real shadow. Can be reset with your own word, in Urdu, Arabic or Latin script.
alt: The word Sabr cut as raised calligraphic letterforms with a brass flourish beneath

title: Bismillah
description: A square piece for an entrance, cut in brushed aluminium so the grain reads as material rather than colour. Set in Naskh when the wording is Arabic.
alt: The word Bismillah cut as raised calligraphic letterforms in brushed metal

title: Shukr
description: Gratitude as a single cut word on a dark wall, where a pale letterform has the most contrast to work with. Urdu wording is set in Nastaliq.
alt: The word Shukr in raised pale calligraphic letterforms on a dark wall

title: Alhamdulillah
description: A panoramic word for the long wall of a dining room or prayer space, where the length of the line is the point. Cut in matte acrylic to stay readable under spotlights.
alt: The word Alhamdulillah cut as raised calligraphic letterforms across a long wall

title: Reception Mark
description: Mark, wordmark and rule in brushed aluminium on 25 mm standoffs — the wall a visitor photographs before the meeting. Can be lit from behind where the wall allows it.
alt: A company mark and wordmark in raised brushed metal letters on a dark reception wall

title: Lobby Wordmark
description: A wordmark stretched across a double-height lobby wall, where a shallow shadow disappears at viewing distance and a 25 mm standoff does not.
alt: A company wordmark in raised metal letters running across a wide lobby wall

title: Entrance Mark
description: A square mark for the wall beside a door, at the size that reads from the far side of a street without becoming signage. Matte acrylic on hidden standoffs.
alt: A square company mark and wordmark in raised acrylic letters beside an entrance

title: Meeting Room Front
description: The wall a video call looks at all day. Sized and placed so a camera frames it behind the person speaking rather than cropping it in half.
alt: A company mark and wordmark in raised acrylic letters on a meeting room wall
